name: The Gift Receipt
source:
A short scifi thriller kinetic novel about a experienced fixer, his companion, and their unexpected find on a space station that's gone dark.

[From [url=https://archaeornis.itch.io/the-gift-receipt]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部简短的科幻惊悚动态小说，讲述了一位经验丰富的修理工和他的同伴，以及他们在一个漆黑的空间站上意外发现的故事。

[来自[url=https://archaeornis.itch.io/the-gift-receipt]itch.io[/url]]
